body:
# Horizons Legends
Welcome to Horizons Legends Lifesteal SMP, where survival is tougher, battles are more intense, and every heart counts! Featuring the stunning Terralith datapack, the world is filled with breathtaking mountains, unique biomes, deep valleys, and incredible landscapes waiting to be explored.

Fight for dominance using the Lifesteal system, where defeating a player steals one of their hearts, making you stronger while weakening your enemies. Discover powerful custom items, unique tools, special abilities, and exclusive content that add new strategies and excitement to your adventure.

Build hidden bases, form alliances, create rivalries, conquer territories, and survive in a world where every decision matters. Whether you're a skilled PvPer, an ambitious builder, or an adventurous explorer, Horizons Legends offers a challenging and rewarding experience for every player.

**✨ Features**

❤️ Lifesteal Gameplay – Steal hearts by defeating players.
🌄 Terralith World Generation – Explore stunning custom terrain and biomes.
🗡️ Unique Custom Items – Special gear, tools, and collectibles.
🏰 Teams, Alliances & Rivalries
🌍 Survival, Exploration & Adventure
🎉 Community Events & Regular Updates
⚖️ Balanced and Fair Gameplay

Steal hearts, forge alliances, explore new horizons, and become a legend! 🌟⚔️🌍
